div.div: كَذَّانٌ Soft stones, (AA, S, M, L, Msb, K,) as also جَذَّانٌ, (As, L in art. جذ,) like dry pieces of clay, (S, L, Msb, K,) and foraminous, or pierced with holes, (M, L,) or sometimes pierced with holes: n. un. with ة. (L, Msb.) Some say, that the ن is a radical letter; (L, Msb;) but the form of the verb أَكَذَّ is against their assertion; for if the ن were so, it would appear in the verb. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
